name: Tugendhat House

sources.locator: Ludwig Mies van der Rohe, printed pages 218-219

circulation: entry at the upper (street) level; a curved stair descends to the open lower floor
section: built into a slope: street-level upper floor, garden-level lower floor
outdoor_relation: lower living level opens to the garden
notes: Regular column grid in the open lower floor; stepped plan outline. Rooms are not labelled at the book's drawing scale, so rooms, adjacency and zoning are not recorded. storeys = number of floor plans published (null where sections show more levels than plans).
